story.title: Our Story
story.p1: NobodyClimb began with one Nobody's love of climbing.
story.p2: On the climbing journey, we are all nobodies. Whether you've just stepped into a gym for the first time or you're a veteran of crags far and wide, everyone has their own story, their own struggles and their own breakthroughs.
story.p3: We want to build a platform where every climber can find information, share stories and make connections. Because here, every Nobody deserves to be seen.
